component_boundary.relationship_to_search: The floating assistant is an independent overlay. It neither moves, hides, queries nor ranks the deterministic documentation search.

collapsed.placement: fixed in the lower-right corner of the visible documentation viewport
collapsed.visible_content: Only the locale-owned assistant title is visible; icons, badges, status, explanatory prose, transcripts and controls are absent.
collapsed.activation: The title is the localized accessible button name and toggles the expanded panel.

desktop_viewport.placement: fixed lower-right overlay with a safe viewport inset
desktop_viewport.article_interference: The panel does not reflow the article or reserve a sidebar column.

narrow_viewport.placement: fixed lower-right overlay with a 1rem viewport inset

expanded.long_content: Only the transcript scrolls; the title, composer and status row remain visible. The transcript never expands the panel beyond its viewport-bound height.
expanded.visual_system: Use existing portal tokens and both light and dark themes; support reduced motion and forced colors.

not_ready.failure: Show only a locale-owned safe reason code when the server reports an installation/preparation failure; never show paths, hashes, prompts, stack traces, credentials or raw exceptions.

installation_progress.visible_when: an explicitly started server-owned installation or preparation operation is active; after reload or documentation navigation, an explicit reader opening reattaches to that operation

state_to_controls.clear: Clear is visible only when the assistant can accept a conversation. It removes the portal's retained display state and invokes the server-owned clear operation; it never deletes an installed model.

persistent_state.scope: one browser tab and one documentation locale
persistent_state.storage: sessionStorage only, under a versioned locale-private key owned by the portal
persistent_state.reload_rule: A reload or documentation-page navigation restores only the retained display state. An interrupted request is not resumed and no partial answer is presented as completed.

copy_authority.rule: Visible UI text is locale-owned. M12B-03 adds the required short labels to the maintained assistant catalog; English fallback is forbidden.
copy_authority.no_explanatory_copy: The widget shows no scope, privacy, resource, search-fallback or model-description paragraphs. Product documentation remains the place for those explanations.

accessibility.focus: Opening moves focus to the title or composer only after a user action. Streaming, status and installation progress never move focus. Escape collapses the panel and returns focus to its title button.
accessibility.keyboard: The title, composer, external-sources switch, clear, stop and install/recover controls use native keyboard-accessible elements. Focus order follows visual order.
accessibility.announcements: The transcript is a polite non-atomic log; the short bottom status is a polite atomic status region. Progress announcements are rate-limited to meaningful state or percentage changes.
accessibility.safe_rendering: All user, assistant, source and reason text is rendered through text-only DOM APIs. The title and sources have localized programmatic names.

security_and_network.page_load: Restoring a collapsed/expanded panel or retained transcript makes no assistant, model, RAG, ordinary-search or external-web request.
security_and_network.installation: Only an explicit user activation may start installation. M12B-05 binds the unavailable assistant control to the bounded same-origin local-model lifecycle, server-owned factual progress and post-verification preparation; it never offers model deletion.
security_and_network.transport: M12B-04 binds same-origin status/chat/SSE/source/cancel/clear routes. M12B-05 binds the local-model lifecycle. M12B-06 binds the M12A-04 tab/locale-scoped external-mode API, switch and separately labelled external claims after explicit reader activation.
